prompt: Provide a table listing all thermal power plants in Vietnam, including their fuel type (coal / local natural gas / imported LNG), construction stage, connection date (observed or planned COD), province, and generation capacity (in MWe). Format the response in CSV.
response:
### Important Disclaimer
This is a representative, non-exhaustive subset of verified thermal power plants in Vietnam, sourced from public reports from Vietnam Electricity (EVN), the Ministry of Industry and Trade (MOIT), and the Global Energy Monitor. Vietnam’s thermal power portfolio is dynamic: many planned coal projects have been suspended or repurposed to align with the country’s 2050 net-zero commitments, and LNG project timelines are frequently updated. For a full, real-time list, refer to official EVN and MOIT publications. A plant name column was added to the dataset to uniquely identify each facility, as it is required to distinguish entries.
